metadata.description: The AURORA Agent (bioprism) plugin marketplace: the FIBER decision-context compiler, MCP tools, mission orchestration, operations evidence, SDK integration, and reusable engineering disciplines.

plugins.name: aurora-agent
plugins.description: The full AURORA Agent integration: bioprism MCP server, FIBER compile/explain/compare/validate/verify commands, mission preflight, ops-auditor, setup, workflow, and SDK skills.

plugins.name: aurora-backend
plugins.description: Wires the bioprism MCP server into Claude Code with a root-resolving launcher and setup skill. Requires a built aurora-agent checkout.

plugins.name: aurora-context
plugins.description: FIBER compiler workflow with compile, explain, compare, validate, and verify commands, the decision-context skill, and a faithfulness eval.

plugins.name: aurora-missions
plugins.description: Mission DAG authoring and lifecycle: preflight, fail-closed gate acceptance, and sync versus async execution guidance.

plugins.name: aurora-integrate
plugins.description: Integration guidance for the bioprism HTTP gateway, TypeScript and Python SDKs, and MCP wiring test harnesses.

plugins.name: aurora-ops
plugins.description: Operations evidence with the ops-auditor subagent and health command over snapshots, capability gates, and recovery posture.

plugins.name: aurora-honesty
plugins.description: The honest-labelling discipline for codebases: claim hygiene, scanner proof, and Windows test truth.

plugins.name: aurora-science
plugins.description: Measurement-science methodology for evaluation: equal engineering baselines, discriminating experiments, certificates, metamorphic evaluation, figures, and research dossiers.

plugins.name: aurora-workspace
plugins.description: Engineering skills for working inside the aurora-agent repository: module authoring, SDK parity, crate verification, and blueprint analysis.
